mechanism: Propylthiouracil can potentiate beta-blocker effects by increasing beta-adrenergic sensitivity and reducing thyroid hormone-mediated sympathomimetic activity, while timolol ophthalmic absorption may be enhanced systemically in hyperthyroid states.
action: Monitor for signs of excessive beta-blockade (bradycardia, hypotension, fatigue) and consider more frequent ocular pressure monitoring; adjust timolol dosing if thyroid function normalizes with PTU treatment.
